def is_known_llm_instrumentor(span: ReadableSpan) -> bool:
    """Return whether the span comes from a known LLM instrumentation scope."""
    if span.instrumentation_scope is None:
        return False

    scope_name = span.instrumentation_scope.name

    # Include extra prefixes from environment variable (comma-separated)
    extra_prefixes = {
        prefix.strip()
        for prefix in os.getenv("LANGFUSE_EXTRA_INSTRUMENTATION_PREFIXES", "").split(",")
        if prefix.strip()
    }

    all_prefixes = KNOWN_LLM_INSTRUMENTATION_SCOPE_PREFIXES.union(extra_prefixes)

    return any(_matches_scope_prefix(scope_name, prefix) for prefix in all_prefixes)
